note: Hardware compatibility notes. Used by driver_check.py for additional lookups.

gpu.nvidia_rtx_40xx: Requires nvidia-driver-545+ or nvidia-open. Excellent support.
gpu.amd_rdna3: Kernel 6.2+ recommended. Mesa 23.1+ for full support.

wifi.intel_ax210: iwlwifi driver. Works out of the box on kernel 5.12+.
wifi.intel_ax200: iwlwifi driver. Works out of the box on kernel 5.4+.
wifi.broadcom_bcm43xx: Needs broadcom-sta or b43 driver. May need firmware-b43-installer.
